result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly coherent, but several elements are clipped or inconsistently styled. The most noticeable problems are the horizontally cut-off restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel (title 'Trattoria Piccol...' truncated at the screen edge), a category chip clipped at the right edge, and inconsistent favorite-button styling between the two 'Popular right now' cards. The second popular card is also cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible title or metadata.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is hard-clipped by the viewport: the image, name ('Trattoria Piccol') and delivery price are cut mid-text with no fade/padding, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/peek amount for the carousel so the next card is only partially revealed at a deliberate offset, and truncate long titles with an ellipsis instead of hard-cutting at the screen edge.

issues.description: The two favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards have inconsistent styling — the first has a white/light circular background with a dark outline heart, the second has a dark circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite-button treatment (same background, icon color and size) across all cards, e.g. a semi-transparent dark scrim with a white outline heart.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza, −20% badge) is cut off by the bottom navigation bar; its title, rating and delivery info are not visible and there is no bottom scroll padding.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped at the right edge, showing only a sliver of the next chip with no affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip row padding so the next chip is visibly partially shown, or add a gradient fade / chevron to indicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: Delivery-fee and metadata text (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') uses light gray on white, likely below WCAG 4.5:1 contrast; icon-only buttons (notification bell, heart) appear to lack visible labels.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text color to meet at least 4.5:1 contrast and add accessible labels/tooltips for the bell and favorite icon buttons.

issues.description: The promo banner's decorative circles are clipped awkwardly at the banner's right edge and overlap the rounded corner, creating a slightly unfinished look.
issues.suggestion: Clip decorative shapes to the banner's rounded-rect mask and reposition them so they don't visually collide with the corner radius or the 'Order now' button.
